answer_text: First, verify network connectivity to the Denver Socket and that CMA can reach it. In CMA, check the socket’s connectivity and review the license status (Account > License > Bandwidth) to ensure it isn’t showing a scheduled license, which can cause the disconnection. If the upgrade or connectivity issue persists, start a manual upgrade from Site Configuration > Socket > Actions > Upgrade, making sure both HA sockets end up on the same firmware version; CMA will indicate when the upgrade completes. If you prefer, you can reattempt via CMA Manual Upgrade to install the latest firmware using the 'Cato Cloud Initiated' upgrade method.
